source: OpenF1 API car_data + location + laps + stints (api.openf1.org/v1)

processing.distance: trapezoidal integral of speed over time from lap start (OpenF1 has no distance channel)
processing.interpolation: speed/throttle/rpm/x/y linear in time; brake/gear/drs zero-order hold
processing.raw_car_data: omitted: file would exceed 80 KB; raw_car_samples_in_lap gives the count
processing.xy_units: metres (OpenF1 x/y divided by 10), F1 timing frame
processing.drs: absent: OpenF1 drs field null for every sample of this lap
processing.dropout_rule: invalid samples (throttle > 100, brake not 0/100, or speed and rpm frozen over 3+ samples) are removed; where that leaves more than 0.8 s between valid samples, speed/throttle/brake/gear/rpm are null on the grid inside the gap, distance across the gap is the X/Y path length, and time_s inside it is linear between the two valid samples
